name: Elisabeth Richelle
original_name: エリザベート・リシェール
source:
A person who is both the chief executive and scientist of a certain facility.
Despite his innocence, he has a violent and sadistic temperament, and
when it comes to the "experiments" on Excelia, he continues to thoroughly blame him using the monsters he created.
Because of that, he is often found to go too far in everything.
translation:

Because of that, he is often found to go too far in everything.
